node.title: True recovered-line tangent slopes inject into discrepancy coordinates
node.statement: For any linear code, write u=c0+e0 and v=c1+e1 with joint discrepancy support T. Finite support-wise MCA-bad slopes whose witness codeword is exactly c0+z c1 inject into T: every bad witness meets T and supplies a root e0(i)+z e1(i)=0 at a nonzero error coordinate, while one coordinate has at most one finite root. Hence their number is at most |T|, and in the official tangent branch at most n-A. No deep-regime hypothesis is used.
